An '''abandoned castle''' stood north of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]],<ref name="Artist" /> the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The castle lay next to a body of [[Water/Legends|water]], had [[Color/Legends|tan]] walls, and consisted of spherical structures that had green roofs. The base of the castle contained a studio with an angled roof and a large window, with numerous framed portraits on its walls.<ref name="Artist" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]<ref name="TEA" /> from [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">"[[The Artist of Naboo]]" was published in ''[[Star Wars Legends Epic Collection: The Clone Wars Vol. 1]]'', which states that the stories within it take place between {{Film|II}} and {{Film|III}}. ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' places the events of these films between [[22 BBY/Legends|22]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], therefore, "The Artist of Naboo" must take place within these years.</ref> a reclusive Human [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Unidentified Naboo artist|artist]] lived and worked in the studio [[Painting/Legends|painting]] [[Star/Legends|suns]] and [[Moon/Legends|moons]]. After encountering Naboo's [[Senator/Legends|senator]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], at a bazaar on the outskirts of Theed, the artist returned to his studio and obsessively painted images of her for twenty-four straight [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]], covering the walls with his portraits. Eventually, the artist had a revelation that Amidala's life was in danger, and returned to Theed to save her life from a Separatist [[Attack on Theed|attack]].<ref name="Artist" />

==Behind the scenes==
The abandoned castle appeared in "[[The Artist of Naboo]]," a comic story written and painted by [[Erik Tiemens]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] in the [[2005]] anthology ''[[Star Wars: Visionaries]]''.<ref name="Artist" />
